meta.title: Withdraw is offered on a live RFQ where Vendor An and Vendor B have bid
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ event with two bids.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled for the RFQ scenario.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where its Settings menu is available.
Verify Withdraw is present and clickable while the RFQ is live.
Select Withdraw to verify that it opens its confirmation window.
Confirm the Withdraw window is open before any confirmation.
Cancel the withdrawal so the event remains unchanged.
Verify the confirmation window closed after cancellation.
